title: ServiceUsability
description: ISO 25011 quality archetype — Usability viability dimension. Degree to which the IT service can be used by specified users to achieve specified goals with effectiveness, efficiency, and satisfaction in a specified context of use. Sub-characteristics: Appropriateness Recognizability, Learnability, Operability, User Error Protection, Accessibility, Courtesy. Rootless archetype — used as qualifier in Directives/Norms. Source: ISO/IEC TS 25011:2017 §7.2.

learnability.description: Degree to which the IT service enables users to learn how to use it. Norm example: ServiceUsability.learnability == 'HIGH'.

operability.description: Degree to which the IT service has attributes that make it easy to operate and control.

errorProtection.description: Whether the IT service protects users against making errors.

accessibility.description: Accessibility compliance level for the IT service. Norm example: ServiceUsability.accessibility != 'NONE'.

courtesy.description: Degree to which the IT service providers show polite and respectful behavior in their interactions with users. Unique to service quality — not present in product quality (ISO 25010).
